steps.content: When the Interrogation Room is lit up, the girl hugging the lantern still has her head tilted in a sweet slumber.
One night not long ago, Letta sleepwalked to the Bureau's gate. She didn't show the slightest sign of resistance when you shackled her and brought her back to the MBCC.
She's been cooperative and compliant during her detention. Aside from her involuntary sleepwalking at night, she's one of the last Sinners you'll have to worry about.

You thumb the envelope with black patterns branded with the Devonshire family name. The graceful couple who gave it to you solemnly requested you to "please make sure this was passed onto their daughter Letta."
Hey, Letta.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Zzz... Hmm... Oh, hello there, Mr. Chief...
steps.female_content: Zzz... Hmm... Oh, hello there, Miss Chief...

steps.content: She rubs her eyes and looks at your blearily before closing them again.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: It's not yet... time for school...
...Letta! Come on, I know you're not really sleeping.
test
test
test
test
test
test
You sigh and slide the envelope to the girl.
Get up and read this letter.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...Letter?
She opens her eyes slightly and glances at the letter.
Yes, your parents asked me to pass it to you.
Letta curls her lip with an unwilling look. Still, she opens the envelope and reads the letter out loud.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: "Dear Letta, how are you? Since you left home, we've been extremely worried."

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: "In fact, we'd long realized you might be going through some drastic change. But as parents, whether our child is an ordinary person or a Sinner, we only wish to protect you the best we can."

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: "And that was why we became even stricter with you."

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: "Although you failed to understand our intention and escaped from your family's protection, we still hope you can receive proper care. Fortunately, the MBCC can provide that."

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: "So Letta, my dear, stay there and forget your childish escape plans. The outside world is complex and cruel to Sinners... We fear you may get hurt."

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: "You've always been a clever child, but you oversimplify the idea of 'choice-making.' Anyway, we believe that you're simply going through a phase."

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: "Do you still remember the Growth Plan we've made for you? That's the life plan we've mapped out for you after meticulous consideration, the best choice you can have."

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: "Once you think it through, hopefully you'll choose the path the most beneficial to yourself and continue to follow it, for that's the plan tailored for you. It'll make you a better person."

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: "Lots of love, Father and Mother."
When she reaches the last sentence, she can't help grumbling softly.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Ugh... Can't believe they still haven't gotten over that Growth Plan!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Nothing more than a boring itinerary...
Letta puffs up her cheeks childishly.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Like it says in the letter, Father and Mother are obsessed with perfectly organized plans... So they also expect me to be the same.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: The Growth Plan is a roadmap tailored for me. They think that so long as I follow each step scrupulously, I'll grow up to be the perfect heiress to the Devonshire family.
Your parents seem to have high expectations for you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Yeah... But they give me a lot of pressure too!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Can you imagine? They picked me up as soon as school was over just so I could attend even more private tutorials. I never went anywhere besides home and school.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I could deal with the heavy schoolwork, but what's worse was that... Father and Mother rarely let me step out of home!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: They always said it was dangerous out there and there were too many distractions. They wanted me to focus on my study... But the outside world just seemed so much fun...
At the mention of that, she starts to sound aggrieved.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: When I was trapped at home, the most I could do was stare out of the window. At school, my classmates were always chatting about fun places they went and interesting things they saw.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: When I listened to them, I felt so envious. Because I'd never experienced those things... naturally... they didn't want to hang out with me...
Feeling a tinge of sympathy for the caged bird craving for freedom, you can't help but agree with her.
I see... That's indeed a depressing life.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: You think so too, don't you? But then, hehe...
Letta suddenly smiles cunningly.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Although Father and Mother always asked me to be a good girl... I was dying to see the outside world for myself.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: So, one night... while no one was watching, I nicked the lantern at home and snuck out!
The lantern in Letta's arms radiates a soft light. You recall that her special ability is cast through this medium.
And the urban legend she's inspired, the Lantern Ghost of Sloane Street, has only become popular recently.
Your guess is that something happened on that day and turned Letta into a Sinner.
Can you tell me more about that night?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hmm... It was very foggy that night in Eastside and there happened to be a Mania attack on the street.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Father, Mother, and the servants were all busy guarding the house and maintaining its Mania defense, so no one thought of me. And there, I stumbled upon a small opening on the defense...
...So you just snuck out through that opening?
Letta gives an exaggerated little nod.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I did!
You're baffled. This little bird has a wild heart. It'll snatch the first chance to flap its wings and break the cage, oblivious of how much danger lurks in the forest.
Stepping out on a Mania-ridden foggy night... Were you aware of how dangerous this was?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Um, yes...
Letta bows her head in embarrassment.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: But... that was my only chance! I wanted to go out so badly!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: You see, I wasn't entirely unprepared either... The lantern I took was embedded with Hypercubes. It would protect me!
Alright... And what did you see after getting out?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: The second I got out, I wanted to find those interesting toy shops my classmates had mentioned. But most shops had shut their doors due to the Mania attack.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I fought so hard for this chance, so I didn't want to just head back like that. As I was still debating, I spotted the silhouettes of some Corruptors in the fog!
You ran into Corruptors?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Yes... I was terrified, I thought they had me... But those Corruptors didn't come close. In fact, they avoided me. It was then I realized that the lantern repelled them!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: So, ugh, that gave a boost to my courage... I decided to wander a little more, hoping to see more interesting things...
How could you... Anyway, go on.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I used the lantern to see and made my way through the fog, into the center of the neighborhood. But little by little, I felt my body becoming heavier and I began to have trouble breathing...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: It was too much and I wanted to go back. But the moment I turned, I saw a ton of Corruptors hiding in the fog, all around me!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: The lantern had gotten dimmer too. The light was dwindling, like it might go out any second. I finally realized... I might not make it back out...
Letta recoils and hugs her lantern tightly. Once she collects herself, she begins again.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I could only retreat step by step with my lantern in my arms, until I was cornered into an alley by the Corruptors. At the moment they were about to reach me, I closed my eyes, and then...
Letta drags out the sentence. You draw in a long breath reflexively.
And then?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: And then I heard the Corruptors' screams! Once those horrible noises stopped, I finally dared open my eyes and found that... they were all gone!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I was alone in the fog, and miraculously my lantern lit up again, even brighter than before.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: It shot a long beam that extended out of the fog. I couldn't see where it ended. Somehow it was guiding me...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: So I followed the beam and kept walking and walking. And before I realized it, I was home!
...You were lucky.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Father and Mother said so too...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I told them I wasn't injured and that the FAC escorted me back, but they still seemed concerned. From then on, they'd become even stricter with me.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: But none of that could stop me anymore because...
Letta bats her eyes complacently.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I discovered that as long as I carried the lantern, I could walk through any wall freely!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: So every night, I would sleepwalk onto the streets! Hehe, it was always so much fun in the fog.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I ran into people who'd lost their ways all the time. Unable to see clearly, they kept walking in circles anxiously... Usually, I'd start by playing a little game with them.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I'd sneak close to them and tap on their shoulders. The braver ones would go entirely stiff and the fainthearted would outright scream. Everyone reacted differently. Oh, I had so much fun!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Then, I'd hold their hands and lead them out of the fog...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Once I sent everyone out of the fog, I'd sleepwalk back home. Father and Mother couldn't do anything about it!
With that, Letta flashes a cute, demure smile, but her eyes are filled with a prankster's satisfaction. The truth is plain as day now.

Faced with Corruptors during her escape on a foggy night, Letta unleashed her potential with her immense survival instinct. With the Hypercubes' guidance, she eventually awakened as a Sinner and saved herself from danger.

Grounded against her will, she frequently used this convenient power to sneak out and wandered in the fog, pranking and guiding lost passersby ignorant of the truth. That's the origin of the lantern ghost.
From your parents' letter, they seem to have been aware of your Sinner identity for some time.
And the strict supervision was their way to protect you... Despite the good intention, it's indeed a bit extreme.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Yes, I know it was for my own good... But I couldn't stand that life without freedom any longer.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Mr. Chief, did you know... I came to the Bureau on purpose so you could arrest me.
steps.female_content: Miss Chief, did you know... I came to the Bureau on purpose so you could arrest me.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: You heard it right! I wanted to go somewhere where no one would intervene in what I did, where I could dictate my life.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I want to make my own Growth Plan.
I see, you already have an idea. What kind of plan do you want to make?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: First of all... I want to go on an adventure!
Letta looks exceptionally excited all of a sudden. She produces a thick notebook and passes it to you. You see the handwritten title on the cover: DisCity Adventure Journal.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hehe, take a look.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: It details all the most unique and thrilling attractions in DisCity I've gathered from the internet, magazines, and urban legends!
You flip open the notebook, whose sensational content makes your pupils tremble.
What's this... The Four Strange Tale Locations of Eastside?
You scan that paragraph of exaggerated description packed with overly dramatized anecdotes.
Ever-blooming flower field, steel maze of the roaring monster, midnight phantom ball, and... eerie castle of doom and mystery?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Aha! You've spotted them right away! These are my top four destinations!
She clasps her hands together against her chest and stares up at you with irresistible twinkling eyes.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Please let me out, Mr. Chief!
steps.female_content: Please let me out, Miss Chief!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Everyone sees me as an urban legend now, but I'm just a knockoff! I want to experience the real strange tales firsthand!
As reluctant as you are to spoil the girl's mood, you remind her tactfully.
Ugh, I must admit these do sound very strange...
But you said it yourself, the urban legend character inspired by you is fake. Likewise, these tales may not be as you imagine...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hmm, you're not wrong. But... but this is a plan I've already finalized! I want to go so badly!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Surely you can indulge me with this little wish, can't you, Mr. Chief?
steps.female_content: Surely you can indulge me with this little wish, can't you, Miss Chief?

steps.content: Hearing no response from you, Letta doesn't seem discouraged at all. She simply closes one eye and makes a puzzled expression.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: If you don't agree, I won't push further...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: But as you know, I have this sleepwalking condition that I can't control.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: They say your dreams reflect your desires... If one night I accidentally wander off, I hope you'll understand it's not my intention at all!
The girl has the most innocent look on her face. Your head starts hurting.
Indeed, with her special power, sneaking out unnoticed is a piece of cake to Letta.
Even though you can locate her with the shackles, it'll be a headache if this becomes a habit.
Okay, Letta. I'll let you go out.
But on one condition. I must go with you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...Go with me?
Yes. You said you wanted to dictate your life, so I won't intervene in any of your actions. Just think of me as... a travel companion.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hehe, hurray!
Letta gives you that adorable, satisfied smile again.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Before you even knew my identity, you were one of the few people who weren't scared of me. Going on an adventure with you must be fun!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Deal!
Letta leaves in high spirits to plan the itinerary. Subconsciously, you sense trouble. Those so-called strange tale locations don't sound too promising...
